entries.english: Add the JavDB operator skill and native packaged-binary smoke coverage for macOS, Linux, and Windows on amd64 and arm64.
entries.zh_cn: 新增 JavDB 操作 skill，以及 macOS、Linux、Windows 的 amd64/arm64 原生打包二进制冒烟覆盖。

entries.english: Handle Windows credential-store permission semantics while retaining POSIX permission checks where supported.
entries.zh_cn: 修复 Windows 凭据存储权限语义，同时在受支持的平台保留 POSIX 权限检查。
